verdict.rationale: IP India's own "Forms & Official Fees" page publishes downloadable forms alongside the statutory fee schedule, so the core capability exists. The evidence does not show that downloading needs no account, and it does not show that filing instructions or guidance accompany the forms. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that downloads work without login, downloadable instructions or guidance for each form, independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account

citations.quote: Official fees are published as the statutory First Schedule with downloadable forms on the "Forms & Official Fees" page
